observations.title: Lewotolok volcano (Indonesia)
observations.description: The Pusat Vulkanologi dan Mitigasi Bencana Geologi (PVMBG) reported continuing eruptive activity at Lewotolok during 17-23 September. Gray or white-to-gray ash plumes rose 100-800 m above the summit and drifted NW and W nearly daily; white plumes rose 100 m above the summit on 23 September. Incandescent material was occasionally ejected onto the flanks and rumbling was sometimes heard. A lava flow on the SE flank that was 400 m long on 20 September had advanced 100 m by the next day. Several webcam images showed incandescent material being ejected above the summit and onto the flanks. The Alert Level remained at 2 (on a scale of 1-4). The public was warned to stay 2 km away from the summit with an extension to 3 km on the S and SE flanks. Source: Pusat Vulkanologi dan Mitigasi Bencana Geologi (PVMBG, also known as CVGHM)
